repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until(not (all(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity <= 30))
fired = false
}
wait until(all(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity <= 30)
all(#Switch).switch_on()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` guard instead of a blocking rising-edge wait. The IR requires the body to execute exactly when the condition transitions from false to true (rising edge). The candidate only checks the condition at the start of every 1-second iteration, missing the precise moment of transition if it occurs mid-period, and fails to block until the edge occurs.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine: a persistent `fired` flag, a block to wait for the condition to become false (rearm), a block to wait for the condition to become true (trigger), and the action followed by marking `fired` as true. This ensures the action fires exactly on the rising edge and respects the 1-second cycle period between firings.
